races.paceDynamic: Lady Kara will set the pace from the front with minimal pressure, as she's the only confirmed leader in this field of 13 mares. After The Ball, Yeld To Call, Miss Denver and Mega Etoile will likely track behind her in prominent positions, but none are aggressive enough to force a searching gallop. The large field of hold-up horses including Hornica, Merely A Detail, Bonnet's Secret and Lilycala will create congestion in midfield and at the rear. This sets up a tactical race with a sustainable pace that will strongly favour the front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid traffic problems and position themselves for a clear run home.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Kara gets an uncontested lead and maintains her jumping rhythm
scenarios.body: She can dictate throughout and prove hard to peg back up the hill, with her proven course form and good going record giving her every chance. The hold-up horses will find the gaps closing as the field bunches for home.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can improve past Lady Kara approaching the final flight
scenarios.body: Yeld To Call or After The Ball can capitalize on their forward positions while the back markers struggle for room in the closing stages. The sustainable early pace will leave plenty in reserve for those handily placed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and the field compresses, allowing traffic-free passages
scenarios.body: Merely A Detail or Hornica could benefit from their finishing kicks if they get clear runs, with their higher ratings giving them an edge. However, they'll need significant luck in running from their likely positions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If the favorites falter and gaps appear for the lesser-rated runners
scenarios.body: Miss Denver or Mega Etoile could capitalize on forward positions if the pace collapses, though their lower ratings make this unlikely. The maidens at the back would need extraordinary circumstances.

watchPoints.text: Lady Kara's jumping rhythm in the early stages will determine if she can maintain her advantage throughout this longer trip
After The Ball and Yeld To Call's positioning behind the leader as they need to avoid getting too far back in this large field
The hold-up horses including Merely A Detail and Hornica finding clear passages from the back as traffic will be intense
Lilycala's market support as the lightly raced mare could have more improvement than her rating suggests
How aggressively the prominent runners track Lady Kara as a slow pace would compromise the front-running tactics

races.paceDynamic: Juggernaut and Seahouses are the only prominent runners in a field dominated by hold-up horses, creating a weak early pace scenario over this stamina-sapping 3m2½f trip. With seven hold-up horses including Scudamore, East Eagle, Floating Rock and Kampari all needing to find racing room in the final stages, the early leaders should face minimal pressure through the first two miles. This tactical setup strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can dictate terms and kick clear before the pack arrives, while hold-up horses face a traffic nightmare and reliance on others for pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Weak Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Juggernaut and Seahouses face minimal early pressure and control the gallop
scenarios.body: The early pace will be steady allowing the front pair to conserve energy before accelerating clear of the trailing pack. Hold-up horses will struggle to make up significant ground against horses who've saved energy by racing unchallenged.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Traffic Problems Behind
scenarios.trigger: If the large group of hold-up horses get shuffled back and meet trouble in running
scenarios.body: Seven horses with similar hold-up styles will create a bottleneck as they all seek racing room simultaneously in the home straight. Only the best-positioned hold-up horses with the strongest finishing kicks will navigate through successfully.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Steady Gallop Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Juggernaut sets a genuinely slow pace from the front throughout the race
scenarios.body: The entire field stays bunched with minimal gallop early, turning it into a sprint finish where class and recent form become decisive factors. Higher-rated horses get their chance despite tactical disadvantages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Kicks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Getaway With You tracks the leaders before making an unexpected mid-race move
scenarios.body: The prompt challenge forces a genuine gallop that stretches the field and eliminates weaker stayers while suiting horses with tactical speed. This creates gaps for the better hold-up horses to exploit late.

races.paceDynamic: Miss Maverick, Max Of Stars, Borna Gem and Mary will contest the early lead, creating a strong gallop over this stamina-testing 2m4f trip at Stratford. With four confirmed front runners in an 11-runner field, the pace will be genuine throughout, stretching the field and testing stamina reserves. The relentless gallop will inevitably crack some of the leaders, setting up the race perfectly for the hold-up horses to finish strongly. This race shape strongly favours the patient, held-up runners who can capitalize on the pace collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the four front runners go too fast early and weaken significantly from 3 out
scenarios.body: The strong early gallop will stretch the field and exhaust the leaders, allowing the hold-up horses with stamina to sweep past in the final furlong. Fromheretoeternity and Callin Baton Rouge are perfectly positioned to benefit from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One Leader Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Max Of Stars or Mary can dictate a controlled pace while others overrace
scenarios.body: The most tactical of the front runners will be able to kick clear when the pace lifts, having conserved energy while rivals burned theirs early. Max Of Stars has the class and experience to judge the pace perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners can stay close enough without getting involved in early pace battles
scenarios.body: D Day Arvalenreeva and Jaminska will track the leaders without overexerting, positioning perfectly to strike when the pace takes its toll. They avoid both the pace duel and getting too far back in a strongly-run race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Muddle Helps Mid-Division
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stop-start due to leaders watching each other too closely
scenarios.body: A messy, tactical affair would nullify the stamina advantages and favor horses that can quicken from mid-division positions. This seems unlikely given the number of confirmed front runners present.

races.paceDynamic: Felton Bellevue will lead from the start with no genuine pace rival in this small field, setting a steady gallop that suits his prominent style. The five hold-up horses (Chief Black Robe, Pescatorius, Unspeakable, Carpe Diem, Yes And Yes) will be clustered behind with Illogical Logic tracking closer. This sustainable tempo will leave plenty in reserve for the closing stages, creating a tactical battle where positioning and stamina matter more than pure speed. The race shape clearly favours hold-up horses who can produce a sustained finish over the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Felton Bellevue sets his typical steady pace without pressure from the prominent runners
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up brigade gets the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks, with multiple horses converging in the final furlong. Chief Black Robe and Pescatorius have the class edge in this tactical finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Felton Bellevue goes too slowly and the field crawls along early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the horse with the best turn of foot wins, likely favouring those with recent form over this trip. Carpe Diem's recent wins and Unspeakable's proven finishing speed could prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Illogical Logic presses leader
scenarios.trigger: If Illogical Logic decides to challenge Felton Bellevue earlier than expected
scenarios.body: This creates a stronger pace that stretches the field and favours those with genuine stamina over pure finishing speed. The Williams-trained pair could benefit from the stiffer test.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front pair dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Felton Bellevue and Illogical Logic steal a march while the hold-up horses wait too long
scenarios.body: The patient tactics backfire as the leaders build an unassailable advantage, with Felton Bellevue proving his recent placed efforts have him primed for success. His stamina and course-and-distance experience become crucial factors.

races.paceDynamic: Three Pikes will be the sole pace-setter early with his prominent style, likely joined by the other prominent runners Klassy Pearl, Chief Sunday, Renoir, Time Interval, and Juan Bermudez settling just off the lead. This creates a moderate early gallop rather than a sprint, with the large field of hold-up horses including Jet Of Dreams, Chicago Storm, Ufouria, Mistral Milly, and Can U Feel It tracking from midfield and rear. The sustainable pace will allow the hold-up horses to close strongly up the home straight at this sharp track. This race shape clearly favours the hold-up merchants who can use their finishing kick over this trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace stays moderate as expected with Three Pikes controlling from the front.
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up brigade get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing speed in the final two furlongs. Jet Of Dreams and Chicago Storm benefit most from their ability to quicken late when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactical Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Klassy Pearl or Juan Bermudez challenge Three Pikes early, forcing a stronger gallop.
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and favours the prominent horses who can stay closer to the pace without overexerting. Time Interval's course form becomes crucial in this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Three Pikes Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Three Pikes gets an easy lead and the field allows him uncontested fractions.
scenarios.body: His recent consistent form suggests he can sustain the gallop when not pressured early. The lack of another confirmed front-runner gives him tactical freedom to dictate terms throughout.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate early pace becomes crawling slow through the middle stages.
scenarios.body: This turns the race into a sprint finish where the freshest horse wins rather than the best stayer. Legendary Day's lower weight becomes an advantage in a cavalry charge finish.

Park Annonciade and Mister Cessna will track prominently behind the leader, while Pure Carbon sits furthest back as the only confirmed hold-up horse. With Bond Broker unlikely to be pressured early, he can dictate terms and control the gallop throughout. This tactical scenario strongly favours the front-runner and prominent racers, making life difficult for Pure Carbon who needs a strong pace to close into.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Bond Broker Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Bond Broker gets an uncontested lead and maintains his jumping
scenarios.body: He can kick clear at the business end when the others come under pressure, utilizing his tactical advantage. The lack of early pace pressure allows him to save energy for a sustained finishing effort.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.trigger: If Park Annonciade or Mister Cessna apply pressure to Bond Broker mid-race

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pure Carbon Strikes

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Mister Cessna Returns

Mister Cessna's early race position - if rusty he may get further back than ideal after long layoff
